verdict.rationale: Authy has a developer API surface (the Authy API and SDKs for common web languages), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents an interactive reference or runnable examples, and the probe records that the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
